FerryWellCo is an Amsterdam team working on environmental context for outdoor activity platforms. GOTime is a product concept that helps people compare heat and air-quality conditions for a planned run, walk, ride or group session. The current example uses heat and PM2.5. Start at the [homepage](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/) or [try a sample planning scenario](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/demo/).

See [For platforms](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/applications/) for potential placements in outdoor apps and a focused pilot approach. The [science page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/science/) covers air pollution, heat and pollen. The [privacy page](https://jonathanthangadurai.github.io/Ferrywellco-Webpage/privacy/) describes the email contact form.
